findings.title: Potential Log Injection via Unvalidated Header: state
findings.description: The query parameter 'state' accepts arbitrary strings with no pattern or length constraints. If this value is written to logs unsanitised, an attacker can inject CRLF sequences (\r\n) to forge fake log entries, potentially hiding malicious activity or framing legitimate users.
findings.remediation: Add a restrictive pattern (e.g. ^[\w\s,;=./@:-]{1,256}$) and maxLength to this parameter schema.
